Name: TheGreatMamoose's Portraits
Author: TheGreatMamoose
Description:
Portrait replacements for the base-game cast in Stardew Valley, including villagers, children, visitors and special characters.

This started as a private mod for my own game. I thought it could be fun to share it so anyone else who likes the portraits can use them too.

The portraits were made using AI and refined through pixel editing. Even touching them up was much harder than I expected, and it gave me a greater appreciation for the skill and craftsmanship involved. I really admire the work of all the artists who create these portraits by hand, and I don't want this project to take anything away from them.

If you'd like to see portraits for characters from mods such as Stardew Valley Expanded or Ridgeside Village, let me know in the comments. If you're enjoying this pack, an endorsement is a simple way to show your support and help me gauge interest in making more.

[size=4][b]Choose one download[/b][/size]

[b]All Seasons[/b] includes supported spring, summer, fall, winter, indoor, festival, beach and work appearances. It requires Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic as a separate download. Outfits vary by character and event.

[b]Base Game[/b] follows Stardew Valley's own portrait selection, including supported winter, beach and work portraits. It does not require Seasonal Outfits.

These are complete alternative downloads. Install only one. Expansion-specific portrait packs are not included.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

Both options need Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.1.10 or newer, and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer.

SMAPI: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
Content Patcher: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915

For All Seasons, also install Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the requirements listed above. For All Seasons, also install Seasonal Outfits separately.[/*]
[*]Close the game and remove any older installation of this portrait pack before updating or switching options.[/*]
[*]With Vortex, choose Mod Manager Download for one portrait file, then install, enable and deploy it. Or extract one portrait download into Stardew Valley/Mods. For a manual install, check that [CP] TheGreatMamoose Portraits contains manifest.json, content.json and assets.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Options and compatibility[/b][/size]

The All Seasons download is up to date with Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic 6.1.4. ApprovedSeasonals defaults to true; set it to false in config.json for the supported default fallbacks. The Base Game file follows the game's selection and has no seasonal toggle.

This pack replaces portraits, not walking sprites or dialogue. Other portrait packs targeting the same characters may compete. Portraiture and PyTK are not required for these downloads.

[size=4][b]Support[/b][/size]

If a portrait is missing or looks wrong, include the character, season or event, selected download, game and dependency versions, a screenshot, other portrait mods, and a SMAPI log from https://smapi.io/log.

To uninstall, close the game and remove [CP] TheGreatMamoose Portraits from Mods. If you installed with Vortex, remove it in Vortex and deploy your changes.

[size=4][b]Credits and artwork[/b][/size]

TheGreatMamoose — collection, direction and curation. The portraits were created using generative AI and refined through pixel editing.

ConcernedApe — Stardew Valley and its characters. Pathoschild and contributors — SMAPI and Content Patcher. Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic — seasonal appearance framework. Dependencies are separate downloads.

Personal use is welcome. Please ask TheGreatMamoose before redistributing this collection, publishing modifications, or using its assets in another project. These terms do not grant rights to third-party material; the relevant creators retain their own rights.
